title: Drifter tuning file
description: One file per drifter type: game/tuning/drifters/<drifter_type value>.json, e.g. meteorite.json. Values only, never behavior (07-drifters.md, rule 10). Loaded and checked by game/app/tuning.py at startup (docs/contracts/systems/app.md, Rules, Tuning loader). Owner of the schema: architect. Contract: docs/contracts/systems/drifters.md. Two rules this schema can't express are also enforced by the loader: default_variant must be one of the keys of variants, and every hitbox shape must lie inside its variant's width x height footprint, centered on the drifter (07-drifters.md, rule 8).

default_variant.description: The variant a placement gets when it names none (07-drifters.md, rule 10). Must be a key of variants.

variants.description: Named variants (07-drifters.md, rule 10). A new variant is a new entry here and needs no code.

speed_ratio.description: Level 1 speed as a multiple of the ship's top sideways speed (core.ship.TOP_SIDE_SPEED, 04-ship.md, derived values). Hazard speed x is applied on top at birth (08-difficulty.md, rule 3). Unitless.

entry_warning_ticks.description: Ticks the entry warning shows before the drifter appears (07-drifters.md, rule 9). Never scaled by level. At least 1: every hazard warns first (07-drifters.md, rule 1).

width.description: Visible width, px. Used for the look, the entry warning and leaving the screen.

hitbox.description: One or more shapes, each placed by an offset from the drifter's center (07-drifters.md, rule 8). Never bigger than the look.

cx.description: Center x offset from the drifter's center, px.

cy.description: Center y offset from the drifter's center, px, y down.

cx.description: Center x offset from the drifter's center, px.

cy.description: Center y offset from the drifter's center, px, y down.

w.description: Full width, px. Boxes are upright.
